parameters.content:
## On event cancellation workflow 

Whenever user will reshedule the meeting thorugh meetng created in calendly then these will trigger and update the date and new time

## On Even created workflow:

Whenever Appointment created in google calendar thorugh calendly then the data will be stored in Appointment_detail booking

## On event updated Workflow

Whenever event cancelled in Calendly then these calendar triggers and update the status of Appointment detail to cancel

## Event canecllation for Inbound call services workflow 

Inbound operation of call also allws to schedule meeting and if meeting canceled in that appointment then these calendar will be trigger and change the status to cancel for that appointment

## hot lead call campaign result workflow 

Lead qualification scenario has done hot lead campaign the status of that call will be recognize here as 
Interested, Lost, Already booked, Meeting scheduled
